items.title: OpenAI’s new Ultrafast mode runs GPT-5.6 Sol 14 times faster, on Cerebras chips
items.summary:
OpenAI wants its cleverest model to also be its quickest. The company has previewed Ultrafast, a new tier of its API that runs the flagship GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14 times the usual speed, reaching around 750 output tokens a second, on hardware built by the wafer-scale chipmaker Cerebras. items.title: Grok Bot Finally Makes AI Agents Easy
items.summary: The OpenClaw promise — teams of coordinated agents doing real chunks of your work — has spent all year waiting for a product regular people could actually use. GrokBot, one of the first Cursor × SpaceX AI collaborations, might be it: virtual computers, watch-and-learn workflows, and a Telegram-simple interface that has the agent-building crowd raving. Plus: Anthropic's text watermarks ignite a firestorm, Gemini hits a billion users, and Nvidia builds a $500 billion financing machine.
